# Savannah Foundation Repair Co

> Foundation repair and crawl space stabilization for homes in Savannah,
> Georgia and Chatham County. Free structural inspections with elevation
> readings and a written scope before any work is quoted.

Savannah sits on the coastal Lowcountry plain: sandy soil over a water table
only a few feet down. Homes here are raised crawl space or slab-on-grade –
basements are effectively non-existent – so the work is crawl space
stabilization, piering, slab leveling, crack repair and encapsulation rather
than the basement waterproofing common further inland.

## Services

- [Crawl Space Repair & Sagging Floor Jacks](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/crawl-space-repair.html): rotted joists and girders replaced, adjustable steel jacks set on poured footings. Locally commonly $1,300–$4,900.
- [Foundation Piering & Underpinning](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/foundation-piering.html): galvanized helical and push piers driven to load-bearing soil for settling foundations. Highest-ticket repair; several thousand dollars upward.
- [Concrete Slab Leveling](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/concrete-slab-leveling.html): sunken driveways, patios, walkways and garage slabs lifted with injected polyurethane foam, usually usable the same day.
- [Foundation Crack Repair](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/foundation-crack-repair.html): distinguishing structural from cosmetic cracking; epoxy/polyurethane injection, or stabilization first where movement is active.
- [Crawl Space Encapsulation & Dehumidifiers](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/crawl-space-encapsulation.html): sealed vapor barrier plus correctly sized dehumidifier to stop the ground moisture that rots framing.

Typical residential job: about $1,600–$4,100.

## Service areas

All of Chatham County, plus Richmond Hill (Bryan), Rincon and Springfield
(Effingham), and Hinesville (Liberty). Eighteen area pages, each covering what
actually fails in that specific place.

<!-- areas:start -->
- [Downtown & Historic Savannah (31401)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/downtown-savannah-ga.html) – settled and cracked masonry piers, rotted sill plates and joist ends, crawl space moisture in tight, low clearances
- [Midtown Savannah & Ardsley Park (31405)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/midtown-savannah-ga.html) – century-old masonry piers under wood-frame houses, crawl spaces that stay wet in the casey canal basin, cracked plaster and sticking doors from uneven settlement
- [Southside Savannah (31406)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/southside-savannah-ga.html) – sixty-year-old crawl space framing and support posts, 1960s slabs cracking over lightly prepared subgrade, settled driveways, walkways and carport slabs
- [Georgetown (31419)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/georgetown-ga.html) – aging crawl space framing and support posts, settled driveways and walkways, original-era piers reaching end of service life
- [Isle of Hope (31406)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/isle-of-hope-ga.html) – nineteenth-century brick and tabby pier foundations, sill plate and joist-end rot around the perimeter, tidal-river humidity under raised cottages
- [Thunderbolt (31404)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/thunderbolt-ga.html) – pier-and-beam settling on low riverside lots, shallow groundwater under the crawl space, salt corrosion of jacks, fasteners and connectors
- [Whitemarsh Island (31410)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/whitemarsh-island-ga.html) – crawl space moisture on lots cut close to the marsh, corroded hardware and fasteners in salt air, drainage failures around 1980s–2000s foundations
- [Wilmington Island (31410)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/wilmington-island-ga.html) – pier-and-beam settling on low-lying lots, rotted framing from repeated crawl space wetting, salt corrosion of fasteners, connectors, and support hardware
- [Skidaway Island (31411)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/skidaway-island-ga.html) – fifty-year-old crawl space framing and support posts, persistent humidity from surrounding tidal marsh, coordinating work inside a gated community
- [Tybee Island (31328)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/tybee-island-ga.html) – pier and piling support under raised cottages, salt corrosion of every metal connector under the house, framing damage from repeated flood exposure
- [Garden City (31408)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/garden-city-ga.html) – shallow footings under 1940s–60s workforce housing, slab cracking on low, filled river-plain ground, settled driveways, steps and entry slabs
- [Port Wentworth (31407)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/port-wentworth-ga.html) – fill settlement under new-construction slabs and driveways, older core housing on shallow mid-century footings, drainage washing fines out from under flatwork
- [Pooler, GA (31322)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/pooler-ga.html) – sunken driveways, aprons, and patios on newer lots, slab cracking over poorly compacted fill, drainage washing soil out from under flatwork
- [Bloomingdale (31302)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/bloomingdale-ga.html) – standing water in crawl spaces on large rural lots, older frame houses on original pier foundations, grading and drainage as the primary fix, not an add-on
- [Richmond Hill, GA (31324)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/richmond-hill-ga.html) – fill settlement under newer construction, slab and flatwork leveling, crawl space moisture on older riverside properties
- [Rincon (31326)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/rincon-ga.html) – fill settlement under recent subdivision slabs, sunken driveways, garage aprons and patios, drainage undercutting new flatwork
- [Springfield (31329)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/springfield-ga.html) – century-old pier foundations in the historic core, fill settlement in the newer subdivisions, crawl space moisture under original, pre-code framing
- [Hinesville (31313)](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/service-areas/hinesville-ga.html) – sagging floors reported late in rental property, original crawl space framing in mid-century housing, moisture damage found between tenancies
